description_en: Queries the list of resource groups of a specified type
description_zh: 该接口用于查看指定类型的资源组列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-resource-groups --resource-group-type 3 --keyword abc --biz-ext-key default --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfmzbn7pti3zfa --tags Value=Test Key=Env --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourceGroups

parameters.help_en:
The type ID of the resource group to query. Valid values:
0: DataWorks
1: scheduling
2: MaxCompute
3: PAI
4: data integration
7: the purchase resource ID generated when you purchase a dedicated schedule resource group
9: dataService
Default value: 1 (scheduling).

When the value represents an engine, the returned resource group list contains the resource groups created when you purchased that type of engine
parameters.help_zh:
需要查看的资源组类型ID。取值如下：
0（DataWorks）
1（调度）
2（MaxCompute）
3（PAI）
4（数据集成）
7 （下单购买独享调度资源组时，生成的购买资源ID）
9 （dataService）
默认取值为1（调度）。

当取值表示引擎时，查看的资源组列表为购买该类型引擎时创建的资源组列表
parameters.name: resource_group_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword. Used for fuzzy matching of resource group names and resource group identifiers
parameters.help_zh: 关键字。用于模糊查询资源组名称和资源组标识
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The category of the resource group. Valid values:
default: public resource group.
single: dedicated resource group
parameters.help_zh:
资源组的类别。取值如下：
default：默认值，公共资源组。
single：独享资源组
parameters.name: biz_ext_key

items.description_en: The details of the resource group

BizExtKey.description_en:
The category of the resource group. Valid values:
default: public resource group.
single: dedicated resource group
BizExtKey.description_zh:
资源组的类别。取值如下：
default，公共资源组。
single，独享资源组

Cluster.description_en: The name of the cluster. This parameter is valid only for MaxCompute and PAI resource group types
Cluster.description_zh: 集群的名称。该参数仅对于MaxCompute和PAI资源组类型生效

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created. The format is Jul 9, 2018 2:43:37 PM
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建集群的时间。格式示例为Jul 9, 2018 2:43:37 PM

EnableKp.description_en:
Indicates whether Kp (key person) access is used. Valid values:
true: The MaxCompute engine uses the Alibaba Cloud account UID as the display name of the access account.
false: The MaxCompute engine uses the Alibaba Cloud account name as the display name of the access account.
This parameter is meaningless for other types and is valid only for the MaxCompute engine
EnableKp.description_zh:
是否使用Kp（关键人）访问。取值如下：
true：表示MaxCompute引擎使用阿里云账号UID作为访问账户的显示名称。
false：表示MaxCompute引擎使用阿里云账号名称作为访问账户的显示名称。
其余类型无意义。该参数仅对MaxCompute引擎生效

Id.description_en: The ID of the resource group

Identifier.description_en: The identifier of the resource group

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the resource group is the default resource group. Valid values:
true: The resource group is the default resource group.
false: The resource group is not the default resource group
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为默认资源组。取值如下：
true：是默认资源组。
false：非默认资源组

Mode.description_en:
The type of the resource group. Valid values:
ISOLATE: an upfront dedicated resource group.
SHARE: a pay-as-you-go public resource group.
DEVELOP: a developer edition
Mode.description_zh:
资源组的类型。取值如下：
ISOLATE：表示预付费的独享资源组。
SHARE：表示后付费的公共资源组。
DEVELOP：表示开发者版本

Name.description_en: The name of the resource group

ResourceGroupType.description_en:
The type of the resource group. Valid values:
0: DataWorks
2: MaxCompute
3: PAI
4: data integration
7: scheduling
9: dataService
ResourceGroupType.description_zh:
资源组的类型。取值如下：
0（DataWorks）
2（MaxCompute）
3（PAI）
4（数据集成）
7（调度）
9 （dataService）

Sequence.description_en: The sequence field. Used to sort created resource groups in ascending order by creation sequence number
Sequence.description_zh: 序列字段。用于将已创建的资源组按照创建的序号从小到大升序排序

Specs.description_en: The detailed information of the resource group. The content displayed in {} is the detailed information of the resource group
Specs.description_zh: 资源组的详细信息。{}中显示的内容为资源组的详细信息

Status.description_en:
The status of the resource group. Valid values:
NORMAL(0): The resource group is running or in service.
STOP(1): The resource group has expired and is frozen.
DELETED(2): The resource group has been released or destroyed.
CREATING(3): The resource group is being created or started.
CREATE_FAILED(4): The resource group failed to be created or started.
UPDATING(5): The resource group is being scaled out or upgraded.
UPDATE_FAILED(6): The resource group failed to be scaled out or upgraded.
DELETING(7): The resource group is being released or destroyed.
DELETE_FAILED(8): The resource group failed to be released or destroyed.
TIMEOUT(9): The operation performed on the resource group timed out. All change operations may time out. This value is temporarily available only for DataService
Status.description_zh:
资源组的状态。取值如下：
NORMAL(0)，表示资源组状态正常，处于运行中或服务中。
STOP(1)，表示资源组已到期，处于冻结状态。
DELETED(2)，表示资源组已被释放或销毁。
CREATING(3)，表示资源组正在创建或启动。
CREATE_FAILED(4)，表示资源组创建或启动失败。
UPDATING(5)，表示资源组正在扩容或升级。
UPDATE_FAILED(6)，表示资源组扩容或升级失败。
DELETING(7)，表示资源组正在被释放或销毁。
DELETE_FAILED(8)，表示资源组释放或销毁失败。
TIMEOUT(9)，表示对资源组执行的操作超时。所有变更操作均可能会超时，该枚举值暂时仅提供给数据服务使用

UpdateTime.description_en:
The time when the resource group was last updated.

The format is `MMM d, yyyy h:mm:ss a`, for example, `Jul 9, 2018 2:43:37 PM`
UpdateTime.description_zh:
最近一次更新资源组的时间。

格式示例为 `MMM d, yyyy h:mm:ss a`，例如 `Jul 9, 2018 2:43:37 PM`

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
